title: The WhataHotel Take: Il San Pietro di Positano

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Il San Pietro di Positano is a small Relais & Châteaux hotel stepping down a cliff below a seventeenth-century chapel.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: The thing to get: you're on that cliff just outside Positano, not in town.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Right. Every room, suite and villa has a sea-view terrace. An elevator carved into the rock drops you to a private beach with a solarium, bar and Carlino restaurant.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Okay, but people really come for the food.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: They do. Zass has a Michelin star, ten organic garden terraces feed the kitchens, and the hotel holds Three MICHELIN Keys. Plus a complimentary boat cruise with swimming and cocktails.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: So that's honeymooners and food lovers.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Exactly. Couples who'd rather stay put. Heated pool, a spa with a hammam, even a tennis court between the cliffs.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Plan around this. It's seasonal, roughly April to October. Kids must be ten or older. And town means the shuttle, though it's free and runs twenty-four hours.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: And it's a cliff, so elevators link the levels. From Naples, take the car-plus-boat transfer; the coast road gets congested.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Bottom line: book it to eat brilliantly and live on your terrace. Want to stroll straight into town? Stay elsewhere.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, you get free breakfast for two daily, a priority upgrade if available at check-in, and a $100 hotel credit.

short_version.atmosphere: Cliffside terraces with sea views and a private beach
short_version.worth_knowing: Seasonal, roughly April to October; children from age 10
